text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian, Albanian and Bulgarian representatives signed a protocol in Ohrid on speeding up the realisation of the east-west corridor.
- Macedonian Culture Minister Slobodan Unkovski signed an agreement in Romania on cultural cooperation between the two countries.
- The opposition Democratic party and the IMRO-DPMNY are a step away from forming a coalition for local elections. The Liberal party is still indecisive.
- Bulgarian foreign ministry delegation visiting Skopje to discuss the "language problem" between the two countries.
